subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: Should maintainers require a live current-main Slack multi-account reaction repro before allowing any fix PR for this issue?
rationale: Current source already has reaction handlers and mocked routing coverage, while the reported failure is a live zero-envelope path that could sit in Slack delivery, Bolt forwarding, account filtering, or authorization.

options.title: Capture live envelopes first
options.body: Keep this issue open and require redacted Socket Mode envelopes plus gateway trace logs before code changes.

options.title: Fold into broader Socket Mode triage
options.body: Treat this as part of the broader Slack Socket Mode/liveness cluster only if maintainers decide the missing reactions are not a distinct event-family failure.

recommendation.title: Capture live envelopes first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require redacted Socket Mode envelopes plus gateway trace logs before code changes.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history signal on the Slack monitor and mismatch-filter boundary that would decide whether proof is sufficient for a fix lane.
